current_prompt.body:
READ the set L = {71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64}
DETERMINE whether L can be partitioned into N=15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each i from 1 to 15
IF a valid partition exists
PROVIDE one example list of the 15 triples (a_i, b_i, c_i)

current_plan.body:
READ the set L
GENERATE candidate triples (a, b, c) from L where a + b = c
SELECT a collection of 15 disjoint triples that together cover every element of L
IF a valid collection of 15 disjoint triples is found THEN
   EMIT the example list of the 15 triples
ELSE
   EMIT a statement that no such partition exists
